title: Entrectinib Monotherapy – Adult
text: Entrectinib Monotherapy – Adult Regimen 00702b For the treatment of adult patient with solid tumours expressing a neurotrophic tyrosine receptor kinase (NTRK) gene fusion, who have a disease that is locally advanced, metastatic or where surgical resection is likely to result in severe morbidity, and who have not received a prior NTRK inhibitor who have no satisfactory treatment options

title: Larotrectinib Monotherapy - Adult
text: Larotrectinib Monotherapy - Adult Regimen 00758a For the treatment of adult patients with solid tumours that display a Neurotrophic Tyrosine Receptor Kinase (NTRK) gene fusion, who have a disease that is locally advanced, metastatic or where surgical resection is likely to result in severe morbidity, and who have no satisfactory treatment options

title: Larotrectinib Monotherapy - Paediatric
